validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="p">
  <state id="p" initial="c">
    <history id="h">
      <transition target="g"/>
    </history>
    <state id="c" initial="g">
      <state id="g">
        <transition event="go" target="d"/>
      </state>
    </state>
    <final id="d"/>
  </state>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: shallow history target `g` is not an immediate child

primary.message: target is outside the permitted subtree

notes: shallow history records only the parent's immediate children, so its default must be one of them; deep history records descendants, so its default must lie inside the history's parent
diagnostics.help: target an immediate child of the history parent, or use `type="deep"` for a deeper descendant
